Newton-Schulz iterations 5→4 (hypothesis: fewer NS steps = more throughput = more tokens; evidence: Turbo-Muon research): val_bpb 0.9032→0.9104 WORSE by 0.007 — 5 NS steps needed for proper orthogonalization at this scale

softcap 15→30 (hypothesis: softcap 15 too restrictive limits model confidence; evidence: modded-nanogpt uses ~23 and Gemma2 uses 30): val_bpb 0.9032→0.9231 WORSE by 0.020 — loss curve shows explosion near end of training suggesting looser cap causes instability during warmdown phase; softcap 15 is well-calibrated

WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1→0.5 (hypothesis: stronger regularization improves generalization; evidence: slowrun shows heavy WD helps): val_bpb 0.9032→0.9296 WORSE by 0.026 — WD 0.5 way too aggressive for this setup; model underfits. Muon WD scaling differs from NorMuon

depth 12→14 same width 768dim (ASPECT_RATIO 64→54 DEPTH 12→14; hypothesis: model capacity limits val_bpb after 4 failed hyperparameter changes; evidence: 2GB VRAM headroom unused): val_bpb 0.9032→0.9007 IMPROVED by 0.0026 despite 10% fewer steps (1705 vs 1910) — deeper model learns better representations per token

depth 14→16 same width 768dim (ASPECT_RATIO 54→48 DEPTH 14→16; hypothesis: deeper model = more capacity; evidence: depth 12→14 improved by 0.0026): val_bpb 0.9007→0.8987 IMPROVED by 0.0020 — deeper model continues to learn better per-token despite 7% fewer steps (1587 vs 1705)

WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5→0.3 (hypothesis: shorter cooldown gives more steps at peak LR; evidence: category switch after 2 arch changes): val_bpb 0.8987→0.9088 WORSE by 0.010 — model needs long 50% warmdown; shorter cooldown hurts final convergence significantly

TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^17→2^16 (hypothesis: 2x more optimizer steps improves convergence; evidence: category rotation): val_bpb 0.8987→0.9105 WORSE by 0.012 — smaller batch = noisier gradients overwhelms benefit of more steps; 2^17 batch is well-tuned

depth 16→18 same width 768dim (ASPECT_RATIO 48→42 DEPTH 16→18; hypothesis: deeper still = more capacity; evidence: d12→14 +0.0026 d14→16 +0.0020): val_bpb 0.8987→0.9033 WORSE by 0.0046 — diminishing returns hit; 16% fewer tokens (192M vs 208M) outweighs depth benefit. Depth 16 is optimal at 60min budget

WINDOW_PATTERN SSSL→SL (hypothesis: more full attention layers (8 vs 4) improve long-range context; evidence: plateau-forced architecture change): val_bpb 0.8987→0.9104 WORSE by 0.012 — throughput dropped 57k→53k tok/sec; 9% fewer tokens (190M vs 208M) not compensated by better attention. SSSL pattern is efficient — local attention handles most context

HEAD_DIM 128→64 (12 heads instead of 6; hypothesis: more diverse attention patterns at same params; evidence: research on softmax saturation): val_bpb 0.8987→0.9109 WORSE by 0.012 — despite higher MFU 91.5% and more steps (1640 vs 1587), smaller head dim hurts quality. 128 head dim better for 768 width at this scale
